name: xiangqi
description: Play server-validated Chinese chess with an interactive Xiangqi board.

interface.shortDescription: Play Xiangqi on an interactive board
interface.longDescription: Start and play Chinese chess games backed by a deterministic rules engine and an interactive MCP Apps board. Xiangqi validates every move on the server, highlights legal targets, enforces turn ownership, and reports check and game-ending states so ChatGPT and Codex never have to guess board legality.
